about: A light document management system with sharing, tags, search and file storage.

prs.title: Read-only shares can no longer delete or rename files
prs.broken: Deleting or renaming a file only checked that you could read its document. Someone given a read-only share could delete or rename the owner's files.
prs.changed: Both actions now need write access to the document, like the other actions that change files.
prs.matters: Sharing a document to read stays read-only, and the owner's files stay safe.
